additional_info.body:
Good evening Mr. Jung,
I am reaching out as Sicharge D Expert form the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0461169.
The ticket was opened for a fault on the charger in date 10.11.2025. Since the charger was running on a very old version (v4.0.11, 2 years old). Therefore, I performed four consecutives updates and the charger is with the most recent and best FW version now,
v8.0.5.
In order to verify that everything works, please let me know during this current week if any fault on the charger appear again. If by the end of the week no faulted state is detected, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
